obligations.behavior: Trigger TDMA schedule_start, timeslot_start, and timeslot_end on inclusive >= PTP (seconds, nanoseconds) boundaries with decimal 10^9 ns rollover within <=3 cycles in STATE_WAIT, and close Nangate45 OpenSTA at clk=1.50ns (WNS/TNS/hold >= 0.00ns, area <= 4500 um^2).

Retain tdma_timeslot_start and tdma_timeslot_end arriving during active start/stop bursts or inconsistent rescans without dropping transitions, and propagate AXI4-Lite reads cleanly across PIPELINE>=2 under s_axil_rready stalls.

Reschedule queues on TX status completion iff queue enabled and permitted by global_enable/sched_enable, and initialize/reset all control, pipeline, and queue_ram fields for Zero-X ASIC gate-level parity.
